C1626.title: Man Uses AI 'One-Click Undress' to Fabricate Nearly 7,000 Nude Photos
C1626.summary: Beijing police uncovered a case in which a suspect, surnamed Bai, used AI 'one-click undress' technology to mass-produce nearly 7,000 obscene images and sold them to 351 individuals via QQ at a price of 1.5 yuan per image, on suspicion of producing and selling obscene materials for profit.
